RS.religion: Serbian Orthodox 81.1%, unknown 5.3%, Islam 4.2%, Catholic 3.9%, no response 2.5%, atheist 1.1%; less than 1%: other Christians, Protestant, agnostic (2022)
RS.etiquette: Serbs are a very friendly, polite and hospitable people, especially in the southern parts of the country. When you are invited into a Serbian home, make sure to bring them a gift if you are coming for the first time. Anything is fine from flowers to chocolate or something representative from your country. When you arrive at a rural house, take off your shoes unless the owner explicitly tells you to keep them on. When inside the house, don't ask for anything, for they will surely offer it. If you are thirsty it is polite to ask for a glass of water. The host probably forgot to offer you a drink and will do so. In a bus or a tram it is considered polite to offer an elderly person or a pregnant woman a place to sit.
RS.title: Serbia

zh.religion: 塞尔维亚东正教81.1%，不明者5.3%，伊斯兰教4.2%，天主教3.9%，无回应2.5%，无神论者1.1%；低于 1%：其他基督徒、新教、不可知论者 (2022)
zh.etiquette: 塞尔维亚人是一个非常友好、有礼貌和好客的民族，尤其是在该国南部地区。当您被邀请到塞尔维亚人家里做客时，如果您是第一次来，请务必给他们带一份礼物。从鲜花到巧克力或具有您所在国家/地区代表性的东西，任何东西都可以。当您到达农村房屋时，请脱掉鞋子，除非房主明确告诉您要穿上鞋子。当在房子里时，不要要求任何东西，因为他们一定会提供。如果你口渴了，有礼貌地要一杯水。主人可能忘记请你喝一杯，但他会这么做的。在公共汽车或电车上，为老年人或孕妇提供座位被认为是有礼貌的。

PW.religion: Roman Catholic 46.9%, Protestant 30.9% (Evangelical 24.6%, Seventh Day Adventist 5%, other Protestant 1.4%), Modekngei 5.1% (indigenous to Palau), Muslim 4.9%, other 12.3% (2020 est.)
PW.etiquette: Palauans have been known throughout history for their hospitality. Many Palauans are very understanding, realize cultural differences, and easily give respect for foreign visitors. Be sure, however, to always pay respect to the local culture. As with any other ethnic group, rude remarks or any form of prejudice against the local culture is not taken kindly. Palauans can be just as angry and rude as they are kind. As long as you do not disrespect the culture, violate historic areas, pollute, or harm the ocean in any way, you will find the local atmosphere very laid back and easy going.
PW.title: Palau

zh.religion: 罗马天主教 46.9%、新教 30.9%（福音派 24.6%、基督复临安息日会 5%、其他新教 1.4%）、Modekngei 5.1%（帕劳原住民）、穆斯林 4.9%、其他 12.3%（2020 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 帕劳人在历史上一直以热情好客而闻名。许多帕劳人非常善解人意，意识到文化差异，并且很容易尊重外国游客。但请务必始终尊重当地文化。与任何其他族裔群体一样，对当地文化的粗鲁言论或任何形式的偏见都不会受到善意对待。帕劳人可能很友善，也可能很愤怒、粗鲁。只要你不以任何方式不尊重文化、侵犯历史地区、污染或伤害海洋，你会发现当地的气氛非常悠闲和轻松。

RU.religion: Russian Orthodox 15-20%, Muslim 10-15%, other Christian 2% (2006 est.)
RU.etiquette: Russians are generally reserved and well-mannered, and tend to be more traditional than other Europeans. This is partly due to the influence of the Russian Orthodox Church, which is a major force in Russian society. Russians take three names, a first given name (имя), a patronymic (отчество), and a family last name (фамилия). The patronymic is the name of one's father plus an ending of -ovich, -yevich, or -yich for men, -yevna, -ovna or -ichna for women. For example, if the father's name is Пётр (Pyotr), the patronymic would be Петрович (Petrovich) for a man, and Петровна (Petrovna) for a woman. To use someone's name informally, you can refer to them using the first or (less commonly) last name, while to do so formally would require either first name + patronymic, or a title + last name. For example, the biologist Ivan Petrovich Pavlov (Иван Петрович Павлов) can be referred to informally as Ivan (if you knew him personally).
RU.title: Russia

zh.etiquette: 俄罗斯人普遍保守、彬彬有礼，而且比其他欧洲人更传统。这在一定程度上得益于俄罗斯东正教的影响，俄罗斯东正教是俄罗斯社会的主要力量。俄罗斯人有三个名字：名字 (имя)、父名 (отчество) 和姓氏 (фамилия)。父名是父亲的名字加上结尾 -ovich、-yevich 或 -yich（男性），-yevna、-ovna 或 -ichna（女性）。例如，如果父亲的名字是 Пётр (Pyotr)，则男性的父名是 Петрович (Petrovich)，女性的父名是 Петровна (Petrovna)。要非正式地使用某人的名字，您可以使用名字或（不太常见）姓氏来称呼他们，而正式地使用某人的名字则需要名字+父名，或头衔+姓氏。例如，生物学家 Ivan Petrovich Pavlov (Иван Петрович Павлов) 可以被非正式地称为 Ivan（如果您认识他本人）。
zh.religion: 俄罗斯东正教 15-20%，穆斯林 10-15%，其他基督教徒 2%（2006 年估计）

RO.religion: Romanian Orthodox 85.3%, Roman Catholic 4.5%, Reformed 3%, Pentecostal 2.5%, other 4.7% (2021 est.)
RO.etiquette: Romanians are quite hospitable. In the countryside and small towns, they welcome foreign tourists and, occasionally, they might even invite you for a lunch. As is common with Romania's Balkan neighbours, Romanians will insist when offering something, as "no" sometimes does not mean "no", and they just consider it polite for you to refuse and polite for them to insist. You should take some normal precautions to study your hosts first. It is common for friends and family to kiss both cheeks upon greeting or parting. Respect towards the elderly is highly appreciated and is a good representation of your character. " During morning and evenings, the phrase changes to "Bună dimineața" and "Bună seara", respectively. Handshakes are a basic form of greeting, used very often and with every meeting. It is always expected to shake hands with everybody when entering a room or gathering of people. Although nowadays it is commonly accepted in Romania for men to shake hands with women, some men still prefer to kiss hands instead, out of tradition (mainly the older ones).
RO.title: Romania

zh.religion: 罗马尼亚东正教 85.3%，罗马天主教 4.5%，改革宗 3%，五旬节派 2.5%，其他 4.7%（2021 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 罗马尼亚人相当热情好客。在乡村和小镇，他们欢迎外国游客，有时甚至会邀请你共进午餐。与罗马尼亚的巴尔干邻国一样，罗马尼亚人在提供某样东西时会坚持，因为“不”有时并不意味着“不”，他们只是认为你拒绝是礼貌的，他们坚持是礼貌的。您应该首先采取一些正常的预防措施来研究您的主机。朋友和家人在问候或分别时亲吻双颊是很常见的。尊重老人是非常值得赞赏的，也是你品格的良好体现。在早上和晚上，这句话分别变为“Bună dimineaşa”和“Bună seara”。握手是一种基本的问候形式，在每次会议上都经常使用。进入房间或​​聚会时总是希望与每个人握手。尽管现在在罗马尼亚，男性与女性握手已被普遍接受，但出于传统（主要是老年人），一些男性仍然更喜欢亲吻双手。

RW.religion: Catholic 39.9%, Pentecostal 21.3%, Protestant 14.6%, Adventist 12.2%, other Christians 4.2%, no religion 3.0%, Muslim 2.0%, other religions 2.0%; less than 1%: Jehovah Witness, not specified, Animist  (2022 est.)
RW.etiquette: Rwanda is a very conservative society, and most people dress modestly, especially women. Wearing shorts or tight skirts and skimpy tops is likely to get you stared at twice as much as normal. It is unusual for a couple to make public displays of affection, even though many men walk hand in hand with male friends. Also, Rwandans will generally never eat or drink in public, apart from restaurants. Rwandan women are rarely seen smoking in public or out in bars unaccompanied. Although there is no smoking ban in most public places like bars and restaurants, generally it's not encouraged. Sometimes people may complain of being disturbed with people's smoking.
RW.title: Rwanda

zh.religion: 天主教 39.9%，五旬节派 21.3%，新教 14.6%，复临信徒 12.2%，其他基督徒 4.2%，无宗教信仰 3.0%，穆斯林 2.0%，其他宗教 2.0%；低于 1%：耶和华见证人，未指定，泛灵论者（2022 年预计）
zh.etiquette: 卢旺达是一个非常保守的社会，大多数人穿着朴素，尤其是女性。穿短裤或紧身裙和紧身上衣可能会让你受到的关注是平时的两倍。尽管许多男性与男性朋友携手同行，但情侣公开秀恩爱的情况并不常见。此外，除了餐馆外，卢旺达人通常不会在公共场合饮食。卢旺达妇女很少在公共场合或在酒吧无人陪伴的情况下吸烟。尽管酒吧和餐馆等大多数公共场所没有禁烟令，但一般不鼓励吸烟。有时人们可能会抱怨有人吸烟而受到干扰。

SC.religion: Roman Catholic 76.2%, Protestant 10.5% (Anglican 6.1%, Pentecostal Assembly 1.5%, Seventh Day Adventist 1.2%, other Protestant 1.7%), other Christian 2.4%, Hindu 2.4%, Muslim 1.6%, other non-Christian 1.1%, unspecified 4.8%, none 0.9% (2010 est.)
SC.etiquette: The environment is a treasured aspect of Seychelles and there are more than 1,000 recorded species of fish around the islands and Aldabra, just one of the islands, is home to the largest population of giant tortoises in the world. Do the effort of respecting it and leaving it clean for visitors to come.
SC.title: Seychelles

zh.etiquette: 环境是塞舌尔的一个宝贵的方面，岛屿周围有超过 1,000 种鱼类，而阿尔达布拉岛（只是其中一个岛屿）是世界上最大的巨龟种群的家园。努力尊重它并保持其清洁以供访客前来。
zh.religion: 罗马天主教 76.2%，新教 10.5%（英国国教 6.1%，五旬节会 1.5%，基督复临安息日会 1.2%，其他新教 1.7%），其他基督教 2.4%，印度教 2.4%，穆斯林 1.6%，其他非基督教 1.1%，未指定 4.8%，无 0.9%（2010 年）预计）

SB.religion: Protestant 73.4% (Church of Melanesia 31.9%, South Sea Evangelical 17.1%, Seventh Day Adventist 11.7%, United Church 10.1%, Christian Fellowship Church 2.5%), Roman Catholic 19.6%, other Christian 2.9%, other 4%, unspecified 0.1% (2009 est.)
SB.etiquette: Solomon Islands society is culturally diverse, and traditions can differ substantially between islands, clans and villages. The Pijin word kastom refers to traditional customs and accepted ways of doing things, while wantok describes the strong obligations connecting relatives, clan members and people who share a language or community. Both remain central to social and village life. Ask permission before entering a village, going ashore on a locally owned island, following a trail or visiting a beach, reef, shrine or cultural site. Your accommodation or guide can identify the appropriate chief, elder or landowner and explain whether an access or kastom fee is expected. Do not assume that an apparently empty beach or forest is public land. Always ask before photographing people, homes, ceremonies, graves, sacred places or cultural objects. Customs vary by province, and a place that appears ordinary to a visitor may have spiritual, ancestral or historical importance to the local community.
SB.title: Solomon Islands

zh.religion: 新教 73.4%（美拉尼西亚教会 31.9%、南海福音派 17.1%、基督复临安息日会 11.7%、联合教会 10.1%、基督教团契教会 2.5%）、罗马天主教 19.6%、其他基督教 2.9%、其他 4%、未指定 0.1%（2009 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 所罗门群岛社会文化多元，岛屿、部落和村庄之间的传统可能存在很大差异。皮金语中的“kastom”一词指的是传统习俗和公认的做事方式，而“wantok”则描述了将亲戚、宗族成员和共享语言或社区的人们联系在一起的强烈义务。两者仍然是社会和乡村生活的中心。在进入村庄、在当地拥有的岛屿上岸、沿着小路行走或参观海滩、珊瑚礁、神社或文化遗址之前，请先征得许可。您的住宿或导游可以确定适当的酋长、长老或土地所有者，并解释是否需要支付通行费或卡斯托姆费。不要假设明显空旷的海滩或森林是公共土地。在拍摄人物、房屋、仪式​​、坟墓、圣地或文物之前，请务必先询问。各省的风俗习惯各不相同，对游客来说看似平常的地方可能对当地社区具有精神、祖先或历史的重要性。

SE.religion: Church of Sweden (Lutheran) 53.9%, other (includes Roman Catholic, Orthodox, Baptist, Muslim, Jewish, and Buddhist) 8.9%, none or unspecified 37.2% (2021 est.)
SE.etiquette: Many Swedes have liberal, cosmopolitan, secular, egalitarian and environmentalist values by international standards, similar to other Nordic countries. This spares Western tourists from some cultural clashes that might be imminent in other countries. However, some strict rules of etiquette are almost unique to Swedish people. There are also intolerant circles. Swedish people are reputed to be rigid and organized. Almost everything has a number. Swedish people have a ten-digit personal identity number (starting by date of birth in the form YYMMDD) used in contact with all kinds of government authorities, usually mentioned before the name. Customers in Swedish shops or banks need to take a queue number note from a machine to be served in order. Each product at Systembolaget is known for its product number (which is often easier to keep track of than foreign-sounding names), and the most important feature in selection is the alcohol content (often divided by price to find the most cost-efficient product). If you order a drink in the bar, be prepared to tell how many centilitres of liquor you want.
SE.title: Sweden

zh.religion: 瑞典教会（路德教）53.9%，其他（包括罗马天主教、东正教、浸信会、穆斯林、犹太教和佛教）8.9%，无或未指定 37.2%（2021 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 与其他北欧国家类似，按照国际标准，许多瑞典人拥有自由、国际化、世俗、平等和环保的价值观。这使西方游客免受其他国家可能迫在眉睫的文化冲突的影响。然而，一些严格的礼仪规则几乎是瑞典人独有的。也有不宽容的圈子。瑞典人以严谨和有组织性而闻名。几乎所有东西都有一个数字。瑞典人有一个十位数的个人身份号码（从出生日期开始，格式为 YYMMDD），用于与各种政府机构联系，通常在名字之前提及。瑞典商店或银行的顾客需要从机器上取出排队号码纸条才能按顺序接受服务。 Systembolaget 的每种产品都以其产品编号而闻名（这通常比外国名字更容易记住），选择时最重要的特征是酒精含量（通常除以价格来找到最具成本效益的产品）。如果您在酒吧点饮料，请准备好告诉您想要多少毫升的酒。

SH.title: Saint Helena, Ascension and Tristan da Cunha

SI.religion: Catholic 69%, Orthodox 4%, Muslim 3%, Christian 1%, other 3%, atheist 14%, non-believer/agnostic 4%, refused to answer 2% (2019 est.)
SI.etiquette: Slovenians are generally open and friendly, so don't hesitate to address people as those younger than 50 understand English and will be eager to help you. You will impress them if you try using some basic Slovenian words. Slovenian is rarely spoken by foreigners, so your effort will be appreciated and rewarded. Slovenians will insist when offering something, as "no" doesn't always mean "no," they just think it's polite for you to refuse, and polite for them to insist. Don't worry unnecessarily, but still you should take some normal precautions to study your host first. Slovenians are proud for having preserved their national identity (especially the language) in spite of the pressures from neighboring nations in past centuries. Due to their economic success as well as historical and contemporary cultural bonds to Central Europe, they usually don't like their country to be described as part of "Eastern Europe". While Slovenian is closely related to Serbian and Croatian, it is not the same language.
SI.title: Slovenia

zh.religion: 天主教徒 69%、东正教 4%、穆斯林 3%、基督教 1%、其他 3%、无神论者 14%、非信徒/不可知论者 4%、拒绝回答 2%（2019 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 斯洛文尼亚人普遍开放、友好，因此请不要犹豫与人交谈，因为 50 岁以下的人懂英语，并且会很乐意为您提供帮助。如果您尝试使用一些基本的斯洛文尼亚语单词，您会给他们留下深刻的印象。外国人很少说斯洛文尼亚语，因此您的努力将受到赞赏和奖励。斯洛文尼亚人在提供某样东西时会坚持，因为“不”并不总是意味着“不”，他们只是认为你拒绝是有礼貌的，他们坚持也是有礼貌的。不必担心，但您仍然应该首先采取一些正常的预防措施来研究您的主机。尽管过去几个世纪以来邻国的压力，斯洛文尼亚人仍为保留自己的民族身份（尤其是语言）感到自豪。由于他们的经济成功以及与中欧的历史和当代文化联系，他们通常不喜欢他们的国家被描述为“东欧”的一部分。虽然斯洛文尼亚语与塞尔维亚语和克罗地亚语密切相关，但它们不是同一种语言。

SD.etiquette: Ramadan is the 9th and holiest month in the Islamic calendar and lasts 29–30 days. Muslims fast every day for its duration and most restaurants will be closed until the fast breaks at dusk. Nothing (including water and cigarettes) is supposed to pass through the lips from dawn to sunset. Non-Muslims are exempt from this, but should still refrain from eating or drinking in public as this is considered very impolite. Working hours are decreased as well in the corporate world. Exact dates of Ramadan depend on local astronomical observations and may vary somewhat from country to country. Ramadan concludes with the festival of Eid al-Fitr , which may last several days, usually three in most countries. If you're planning to travel to Sudan during Ramadan, consider reading Travelling during Ramadan . In general, the Sudanese are hospitable, sociable people. They consider it shameful to give someone a poor welcome, so you can expect to be treated with immense respect as a tourist.
SD.title: Sudan

zh.etiquette: 斋月是伊斯兰历的第九个月，也是最神圣的月份，持续 29 至 30 天。穆斯林在斋戒期间每天都要斋戒，大多数餐馆都会关门，直到黄昏斋戒结束。从黎明到日落，任何东西（包括水和香烟）都不应该通过嘴唇。非穆斯林不受此限制，但仍应避免在公共场所饮食，因为这被认为是非常不礼貌的。企业界的工作时间也减少了。斋月的确切日期取决于当地的天文观测，并且因国家/地区而异。斋月以开斋节结束，开斋节可能持续数天，在大多数国家通常为三天。如果您计划在斋月期间前往苏丹，请考虑阅读斋月期间旅行。总的来说，苏丹人热情好客、善于交际。他们认为对某人进行粗俗的欢迎是可耻的，因此您可以期待作为游客受到极大的尊重。
zh.religion: 逊尼派穆斯林，基督教少数群体

SG.religion: Buddhist 31.1%, Christian 18.9%, Muslim 15.6%, Taoist 8.8%, Hindu 5%, other 0.6%, none 20% (2020 est.)
SG.etiquette: Chinese place their family name first, so Phua Chu Kang is Mr. Phua for business and Chu Kang (or just CK) to his friends. Many have Western names, so he may also be known as Terry Phua . Malay names are given name + bin or binti (son/daughter) + father's name. Mohammed bin Abdullah would usually be called Mr. Mohammed. Sometimes, the person's given name appears after the Mohammed or Abdul (example: Mohammed Faizal bin Abdul Nasser ) so, in such a case, he would usually be addressed as Mr. Faizal. Indian names are complex, but the south Indian (Tamil) names usually found in Singapore have two patterns: either given name + s/o or d/o (son of/daughter of) + father's name, or father's initial + given name. R. Nathan and would be addressed as Mr. Nathan. The foolproof method is to ask how the person wants to be addressed. Singaporeans care little about formal politeness. What would be decent behaviour at home, wherever home might be, is unlikely to offend anyone in Singapore. g.
SG.title: Singapore

zh.etiquette: 中国人把姓放在第一位，所以 Phu​​a Chu Kang 在生意上是 Phua 先生，在朋友那里是 Chu Kang（或简称 CK）。许多人都有西方名字，所以他也可能被称为 Terry Phua。马来名字是名字+bin或binti（儿子/女儿）+父亲的名字。穆罕默德·本·阿卜杜拉通常被称为穆罕默德先生。有时，此人的名字出现在穆罕默德或阿卜杜勒之后（例如：穆罕默德·费扎尔·本·阿卜杜勒·纳赛尔），因此在这种情况下，他通常会被称为费扎尔先生。印度名字很复杂，但在新加坡常见的南印度（泰米尔）名字有两种模式：名字+s/o或d/o（儿子/女儿）+父亲的名字，或者父亲的名字首字母+名字。 R. Nathan，将被称为 Nathan 先生。最简单的方法是询问对方希望如何称呼他。新加坡人不太关心正式的礼貌。无论家在哪里，在家里的体面行为不太可能冒犯新加坡的任何人。 g。

zh.etiquette: 斋月是伊斯兰历的第九个月，也是最神圣的月份，持续 29 至 30 天。穆斯林在斋戒期间每天都要斋戒，大多数餐馆都会关门，直到黄昏斋戒结束。从黎明到日落，任何东西（包括水和香烟）都不应该通过嘴唇。非穆斯林不受此限制，但仍应避免在公共场所饮食，因为这被认为是非常不礼貌的。企业界的工作时间也减少了。斋月的确切日期取决于当地的天文观测，并且因国家/地区而异。斋月以开斋节结束，开斋节可能持续数天，在大多数国家通常为三天。如果您计划在斋月期间前往塞拉利昂，请考虑阅读斋月期间旅行。

SK.religion: Roman Catholic 55.8%, Evangelical Church of the Augsburg Confession 5.3%, Greek Catholic 4%, Reformed Christian 1.6%, other 3%, none 23.8%, unspecified 6.5% (2021 est.)
SK.etiquette: Slovaks are friendly and peaceful people living in a free, democratic state. There are not really issues that would provoke actual hostility or trouble. Usually the worst thing that can happen is that you would be thought a bit boorish and have some history explained to you over a beer. However, it pays to be respectful and sensitive when discussing certain topics. Slovaks are quite hospitable, and if they invite you into their home, expect to be well looked after and offered a variety of food and drinks. If you are invited in for lunch, expect a 2-3 course meal just as for dinner, as lunch is traditionally the main meal of the day. It is considered polite to bring a small gift for the host, such as a bottle of wine or good spirit, a box of chocolates, or a small bouquet of flowers, but never give money as it would be felt that you are trying to pay for the hospitality.
SK.title: Slovakia

zh.religion: 罗马天主教 55.8%、奥格斯堡福音派 5.3%、希腊天主教 4%、改革宗基督教 1.6%、其他 3%、无 23.8%、未指定 6.5%（2021 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 斯洛伐克人是友好和平的人民，生活在自由、民主的国家。并不存在真正会引起实际敌意或麻烦的问题。通常最糟糕的事情是，你会被认为有点粗鲁，而有人会边喝啤酒边向你解释一些历史。然而，在讨论某些话题时保持尊重和敏感是值得的。斯洛伐克人非常热情好客，如果他们邀请您到他们家做客，您会受到很好的照顾并提供各种食物和饮料。如果您受邀共进午餐，预计会像晚餐一样享用 2-3 道菜，因为传统上午餐是一天中的主餐。给主人带一份小礼物被认为是有礼貌的，比如一瓶葡萄酒或烈酒、一盒巧克力或一小束鲜花，但千万不要给钱，因为这会让人觉得你在为招待付钱。

SM.etiquette: Despite sharp political differences, some of the various respect tips found in the Italy article will come in handy when visiting the country. Though Italian is the official language of the country, do not act as if San Marino is a part of Italy and do not confuse the Sammarinese with Italians. This is likely to cause offence. Be respectful when taking photos with the guards. A smile will do, but hand gestures/funny faces will not be received well. The Sammarinese tend to take politics of their nation very seriously. You're unlikely to cause offence by asking about the country's political situation.
SM.title: San Marino

zh.religion: 罗马天主教
zh.etiquette: 尽管政治分歧很大，但意大利文章中的一些尊重提示在访问该国时会派上用场。尽管意大利语是该国的官方语言，但不要表现得好像圣马力诺是意大利的一部分，也不要将圣马力诺人与意大利人混淆。这可能会引起冒犯。与警卫合影时要保持尊重。微笑可以，但手势/滑稽的表情不会被很好地接受。圣马力诺人往往非常严肃地对待他们国家的政治。询问该国的政治局势不太可能引起冒犯。

SO.religion: Muslim 99.9% (Sunni Muslim 98.1%, Shia Muslim 1.2%, Islamic schismatic 0.6%), ethnic religionist 0.1% (2020 est.)
SO.etiquette: Ramadan is the 9th and holiest month in the Islamic calendar and lasts 29–30 days. Muslims fast every day for its duration and most restaurants will be closed until the fast breaks at dusk. Nothing (including water and cigarettes) is supposed to pass through the lips from dawn to sunset. Non-Muslims are exempt from this, but should still refrain from eating or drinking in public as this is considered very impolite. Working hours are decreased as well in the corporate world. Exact dates of Ramadan depend on local astronomical observations and may vary somewhat from country to country. Ramadan concludes with the festival of Eid al-Fitr , which may last several days, usually three in most countries. If you're planning to travel to Somalia during Ramadan, consider reading Travelling during Ramadan . Somalis, in general, are humble, hospitable, and welcoming. They consider it shameful to not give a guest a warm welcome, which is why you, as a tourist, will be showered with hospitality, even if you end up making a few blunders here and there.
SO.title: Somalia

zh.religion: 穆斯林 99.9%（逊尼派穆斯林 98.1%，什叶派穆斯林 1.2%，伊斯兰分裂派 0.6%），少数民族宗教徒 0.1%（2020 年估计）

SR.etiquette: Be respectful when taking photographs. Like everywhere else, one should respect the environment and the culture. For example the inland-people consider certain trees and spots holy and it is likely you need consent before taking a photograph. Your local guide will usually also indicate this. Ask for consent when you think it is appropriate as you would anywhere else.
SR.title: Suriname

zh.etiquette: 拍照时要保持尊重。像其他地方一样，人们应该尊重环境和文化。例如，内陆人民认为某些树木和地点是神圣的，在拍照之前您可能需要征得同意。您当地的导游通常也会指出这一点。当您认为适当时征求同意，就像在其他地方一样。

TN.religion: Muslim (official; Sunni) 99%, other (includes Christian, Jewish, Shia Muslim, and Baha'i) <1%
TN.etiquette: Tunisia is a Muslim-majority country, and one should be mindful of the dress code depending on the region. Whilst a lot of skin (even topless) is tolerated on beaches and within hotel complexes, a modest amount of exposed skin may be frowned upon outside these areas. That said, the country is also home to long-established Christian and Jewish minorities who are free to practice their religions, but may not proselytize to Muslims. Be aware that the further south one travels, the more conservative Tunisia becomes. While most women wear western-style clothing in the Capital (which is a mix of Mediterranean, European and Middle Eastern cultures), Southern Tunisia is more conservative and far more traditional. Ramadan is the 9th and holiest month in the Islamic calendar and lasts 29–30 days. Muslims fast every day for its duration and most restaurants will be closed until the fast breaks at dusk. Nothing (including water and cigarettes) is supposed to pass through the lips from dawn to sunset.
TN.title: Tunisia

zh.religion: 穆斯林（官方；逊尼派）99%，其他（包括基督教、犹太教、什叶派穆斯林和巴哈伊教）<1%
zh.etiquette: 突尼斯是一个穆斯林占多数的国家，人们应该注意不同地区的着装要求。虽然在海滩和酒店大楼内可以容忍大量的皮肤（甚至赤裸上身），但在这些区域之外，少量暴露的皮肤可能会令人皱眉。也就是说，该国也是历史悠久的基督教和犹太少数群体的家园，他们可以自由地信奉自己的宗教，但不得向穆斯林传教。请注意，越往南走，突尼斯就会变得越保守。虽然首都的大多数女性都穿着西式服装（地中海、欧洲和中东文化的混合体），但突尼斯南部却更加保守、传统得多。斋月是伊斯兰历的第九个月，也是最神圣的月份，持续 29 至 30 天。穆斯林在斋戒期间每天都要斋戒，大多数餐馆都会关门，直到黄昏斋戒结束。从黎明到日落，任何东西（包括水和香烟）都不应该通过嘴唇。

Handshakes are key. Also, maybe if you try to get to know them, you will fit in. Make sure you make yourself feel like you are at home.

TO.religion: Protestant 63.9% (Free Wesleyan Church 34.2%, Free Church of Tonga 11.3%, Church of Tonga 6.8%, Seventh Day Adventist 2.5%, Assembly of God 2.5%, Tokaikolo/Maamafo'ou 1.5%, Constitutional Church of Tonga 1.2%, other Protestant 4%), Church of Jesus Christ 19.7%, Roman Catholic 13.7%, other 2.1%, none 0.6%, no answer 0.1% (2021 est.)
TO.etiquette: Tongans in general tend to have a relaxed attitude towards life. They place a lot of emphasis on humility and hospitality. Being a conservative, highly religious country, Tongan culture is heavily influenced by Christian values and principles.
TO.title: Tonga

zh.etiquette: 汤加人总体上倾向于采取轻松的生活态度。他们非常重视谦逊和热情好客。作为一个保守、高度宗教化的国家，汤加文化深受基督教价值观和原则的影响。

TT.religion: Protestant 32.1% (Pentecostal/Evangelical/Full Gospel 12%, Baptist 6.9%, Anglican 5.7%, Seventh Day Adventist 4.1%, Presbyterian/Congregational 2.5%, other Protestant 0.9%), Roman Catholic 21.6%, Hindu 18.2%, Muslim 5%, Jehovah's Witness 1.5%, other 8.4%, none 2.2%, unspecified 11.1% (2011 est.)
TT.etiquette: It's a good idea to greet a stranger before asking him or her a question. It's a better idea to avoid strangers when not in the company of others. Many Trinbagonians like to discuss sports. Being a former British colony, these discussions usually centre mostly around cricket and football. In Trinidad and Tobago, many of the world's great religions are well represented. Christianity is the majority religion of the country, and there are also significant Hindu and Muslim minorities. Tolerance for religious and ethnic differences is high.
TT.title: Trinidad and Tobago

zh.religion: 新教 32.1%（五旬节派/福音派/全备福音派 12%，浸信会 6.9%，英国圣公会 5.7%，基督复临安息日会 4.1%，长老会/公理会 2.5%，其他新教 0.9%），罗马天主教 21.6%，印度教 18.2%，穆斯林 5%，耶和华见证人1.5%，其他 8.4%，无 2.2%，未指定 11.1%（2011 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 在问陌生人问题之前先打招呼是个好主意。当没有其他人陪伴时，最好避开陌生人。许多特林巴贡人喜欢讨论体育。作为前英国殖民地，这些讨论通常主要围绕板球和足球。在特立尼达和多巴哥，世界上许多伟大的宗教都有很好的代表。基督教是该国的多数宗教，还有大量的印度教和穆斯林少数群体。对宗教和种族差异的容忍度很高。

TV.title: Tuvalu

UY.religion: Roman Catholic 36.5%, Protestant 5% (Evangelical (non-specific) 4.6%, Adventist 0.2%, Protestant (non-specific) 0.3%), African American Cults/Umbanda 2.8%, Jehovah's Witness 0.6%, Church of Jesus Christ 0.2%, other 1%, Believer (not belonging to the church) 1.8%, agnostic 0.3%, atheist 1.3%, none 47.3%, unspecified 3.4%  Roman Catholic 42%, Protestant 15%, other 6%, agnostic 3%, atheist 10%, unspecified 24% (2023 est.)
UY.etiquette: Uruguay is a socially progressive country. Women got the vote in Uruguay 12 years before France. Uruguay is a secular state unlike Argentina, Chile or Paraguay; the Uruguayan state has not supported any religion since 1917. Even national holidays are officially referred to with secular names—the week before Easter is officially "Tourism Week" and December 25th is "Family Day"! The population is mainly Catholic, but not very practicing. Uruguay is considered to be safe and welcoming to gay and lesbian visitors : it is ranked 12th in the world in the Spartacus Gay Travel Index . It was the first Latin American country to pass a civil union law, and same-sex marriage was legalized in mid-2013. Even in rural areas, gay travelers experience little overt discrimination. There are a few gay and lesbian bars in Montevideo and in Punta del Este. The only public monument to sexual diversity is in Ciudad Vieja (the old city) in Montevideo.
UY.title: Uruguay

zh.religion: 罗马天主教 36.5%、新教 5%（福音派（非特定）4.6%、复临信徒 0.2%、新教（非特定）0.3%）、非洲裔美国邪教/乌班达 2.8%、耶和华见证人 0.6%、耶稣基督教会 0.2%、其他 1%、信徒（不属于教会）1.8%、不可知论0.3%，无神论者 1.3%，无神论者 47.3%，未指定 3.4% 罗马天主教 42%，新教 15%，其他 6%，不可知论者 3%，无神论者 10%，未指定 24%（2023 年估计）
zh.etiquette: 乌拉圭是一个社会进步的国家。乌拉圭女性比法国早 12 年获得投票权。乌拉圭是一个世俗国家，与阿根廷、智利或巴拉圭不同。乌拉圭国家自1917年以来就不再支持任何宗教。就连国家法定节假日也正式以世俗名称称呼——复活节前一周正式为“旅游周”，12月25日为“家庭日”！居民主要信奉天主教，但信仰天主教的人并不多。乌拉圭被认为是一个安全且欢迎同性恋游客的国家：它在斯巴达克斯同性恋旅游指数中排名世界第 12 位。它是第一个通过民事结合法的拉丁美洲国家，同性婚姻于 2013 年中期合法化。即使在农村地区，同性恋旅行者也很少受到明显的歧视。蒙得维的亚和埃斯特角城有一些同性恋酒吧。唯一的性别多样性公共纪念碑位于蒙得维的亚的 Ciudad Vieja（旧城）。

US.religion: Protestant 46.5%, Roman Catholic 20.8%, Jewish 1.9%, Church of Jesus Christ 1.6%, other Christian 0.9%, Muslim 0.9%, Jehovah's Witness 0.8%, Buddhist 0.7%, Hindu 0.7%, other 1.8%, unaffiliated 22.8%, don't know/refused 0.6% (2014 est.)
US.etiquette: Cultural norms vary significantly from region to region. In general, social etiquette tends to be more formal in the Northeast and the South , more casual on the West Coast, and somewhere between those two extremes in the Midwest . S. tends to be fairly casual . For everyday clothes, jeans and T-shirts are always acceptable, as are shorts when the weather is suitable. Sneakers (athletic shoes) are common; flip-flops and sandals are also popular in warm weather. In the winter in northern states, boots are commonly worn. In general, dress code is a bit more formal in the metropolises of the East Coast, and in the South (where "Southern style" is a surviving concept), and more relaxed the further west you go. See also Working in the United States . In more conservative areas, it is customary for people to dress up when they go to church on Sundays. Generally, Americans accept religious attire such as yarmulkes, hijabs and burqas without comment.
US.title: United States

zh.religion: 新教 46.5%、罗马天主教 20.8%、犹太教 1.9%、耶稣基督教会 1.6%、其他基督教 0.9%、穆斯林 0.9%、耶和华见证人 0.8%、佛教 0.7%、印度教 0.7%、其他 1.8%、无宗教归属 22.8%、不知道/拒绝 0.6%（2014 年）预计）
zh.etiquette: 不同地区的文化规范差异很大。一般来说，东北部和南部的社交礼仪更为正式，西海岸的社交礼仪更为随意，而中西部的社交礼仪则介于这两个极端之间。 S. 往往相当随意。日常着装方面，牛仔裤和 T 恤都是可以接受的，天气合适时也可以穿短裤。运动鞋（运动鞋）很常见；人字拖和凉鞋在温暖的天气也很受欢迎。在北方各州的冬天，人们通常穿靴子。一般来说，在东海岸和南方的大都市（“南方风格”是一个幸存的概念），着装要求稍微正式一点，而越往西走就越放松。另请参阅在美国工作。在较为保守的地区，人们习惯于周日去教堂时盛装打扮。一般来说，美国人接受圆顶小帽、头巾和罩袍等宗教服装，但不加评论。

VN.religion: Catholic 6.1%, Buddhist 5.8%, Protestant 1%, other 0.8%, none 86.3% (2019 est.)
VN.etiquette: Vietnamese people generally follow East Asian naming traditions, with a family name followed by a given name. However, unlike in other East Asian cultures, the family name is almost never used when addressing an individual, and the default form of address would be to use a title followed by the second given name. Titles are a complicated business in Vietnamese, which vary based on gender and seniority relative to you; see the Vietnamese phrasebook for a discussion on Vietnamese titles you can use when addressing others. For instance, the former prime minister of Vietnam, Nguyen Xuan Phuc, has the family name Nguyen, and the given name Xuan Phuc. However, according to Vietnamese custom, he is never addressed as Mr Nguyen, and people would address him as Mr Phuc in English even in the most formal situations. In traditional Vietnamese culture, elders are treated with great deference and respect. While expectations are more relaxed when foreigners are involved, it's a good idea to show politeness, respect and restraint towards those who look older than you.
VN.title: Vietnam

zh.etiquette: 越南人普遍遵循东亚命名传统，先姓后名。然而，与其他东亚文化不同的是，在称呼个人时几乎从不使用姓氏，默认的称呼形式是使用头衔后跟第二个名字。在越南语中，头衔是一件复杂的事情，它根据性别和相对于你的资历而有所不同；请参阅越南语常用语手册，了解有关在向他人讲话时可以使用的越南语标题的讨论。例如，越南前总理阮春福，姓阮，名春福。然而，根据越南习俗，他从不被称为“Nguyen”，即使在最正式的场合，人们也会用英语称呼他为“Mr Phuc”。在越南传统文化中，长辈受到极大的尊重。虽然当外国人参与时，期望会更放松，但对那些看起来比你年长的人表现出礼貌、尊重和克制是个好主意。

VE.etiquette: Most Venezuelans are laid-back regarding racial issues, since white or creole persons blend naturally with natives and Afro-Venezuelans in everyday life (education, living, politics, marriage). So the word "negro" can be used regardless of who's saying it, or who is being referred to in this way. Expressions like "negrito" or "mi negro" are often used as a term of endearment. You could hear someone calling "negra" to a woman, regardless of the race of the person. And in general, Afro-Venezuelans don't find it offensive, as they are simply variations on the Spanish word for "black". Similarly, don't be offended if someone calls you "flaco" (thin) or "gordo" (fat) as these may also be used fairly indiscriminately, and often as a term of friendliness. Differences between Brits, Americans, or Europeans are not perceived by most Venezuelans. Hence, you can expect to be called "gringo" even if you are, say, Russian. Don't let this offend you as a non Spanish-speaking visitor; Venezuelans are not trying to be offensive.
VE.title: Venezuela

zh.etiquette: 大多数委内瑞拉人在种族问题上态度悠闲，因为白人或克里奥尔人在日常生活（教育、生活、政治、婚姻）中与当地人和非裔委内瑞拉人自然地融合在一起。因此，无论谁在说这个词，或者以这种方式提及谁，都可以使用“negro”这个词。像“negrito”或“mi negro”这样的表达方式经常被用作表达爱意的词语。您可以听到有人对女性喊“negra”，无论该人的种族如何。一般来说，非洲裔委内瑞拉人并不觉得这有冒犯性，因为它们只是西班牙语“黑色”一词的变体。同样，如果有人称您为“flaco”（瘦）或“gordo”（胖），请不要生气，因为这些词也可能被相当不加区别地使用，并且通常作为友好用语。大多数委内瑞拉人并没有意识到英国人、美国人或欧洲人之间的差异。因此，即使您是俄罗斯人，也可能会被称为“外国佬”。作为一个非西班牙语访客，请不要让这冒犯您；委内瑞拉人并不想冒犯。

ZA.etiquette: South Africans are generally polite, friendly and accommodating to tourists. Talking slightly loud outdoors is quite normal, as South Africans tend to be a free thinking and exuberant bunch of people and such behaviour is ok amongst friends and acquaintances. Strangers should observe general protocols of politeness at first and if accepted, "when in Rome, do like Romans do". Smiling and acknowledging strangers is normal behaviour and a slight head nod or hand wave common practice. , also happens regularly. Public behaviour is very similar to what you might find in Europe. Heterosexual displays of affection in public are not frowned upon unless you overdo it. Homosexual displays of affection may generate unwelcome attention although they will be tolerated and respected in the more gay-friendly and cosmopolitan areas of Johannesburg (Sandton, Rosebank and Parkhurst), Cape Town (Greenpoint, Clifton and De Waterkant) and Durban. South Africa was the first African nation where the government recognizes same-sex relationships and homosexual marriages are recognized by law. Men generally greet with a firm handshake, while women will do the continental kiss on the cheek.
ZA.title: South Africa

zh.etiquette: 南非人普遍对游客有礼貌、友好和包容。在户外大声说话是很正常的，因为南非人往往是一群思想自由、精力充沛的人，在朋友和熟人之间这种行为是可以接受的。陌生人首先应该遵守一般的礼貌礼仪，如果被接受，“在罗马，就像罗马人一样”。微笑并与陌生人打招呼是正常行为，轻微点头或挥手也是常见做法。 ，也经常发生。公共行为与欧洲的情况非常相似。异性恋在公共场合表达爱意不会被人反对，除非你做得太过分。同性恋表达爱意可能会引起不受欢迎的关注，尽管在约翰内斯堡（桑顿、罗斯班克和帕克赫斯特）、开普敦（绿点、克利夫顿和德沃特坎特）和德班等对同性恋更加友好和国际化的地区，同性恋表达爱意会受到容忍和尊重。南非是第一个政府承认同性关系和法律承认同性婚姻的非洲国家。男性通常会用力握手打招呼，而女性则会在脸颊上进行欧陆式亲吻。

YE.etiquette: Ramadan is the 9th and holiest month in the Islamic calendar and lasts 29–30 days. Muslims fast every day for its duration and most restaurants will be closed until the fast breaks at dusk. Nothing (including water and cigarettes) is supposed to pass through the lips from dawn to sunset. Non-Muslims are exempt from this, but should still refrain from eating or drinking in public as this is considered very impolite. Working hours are decreased as well in the corporate world. Exact dates of Ramadan depend on local astronomical observations and may vary somewhat from country to country. Ramadan concludes with the festival of Eid al-Fitr , which may last several days, usually three in most countries. If you're planning to travel to Yemen during Ramadan, consider reading Travelling during Ramadan . Yemenis, North Africans , and Arabs in the Gulf share a common culture; therefore, what is considered good manners in the Arab world is applicable to Yemen.
YE.title: Yemen

zh.etiquette: 斋月是伊斯兰历的第九个月，也是最神圣的月份，持续 29 至 30 天。穆斯林在斋戒期间每天都要斋戒，大多数餐馆都会关门，直到黄昏斋戒结束。从黎明到日落，任何东西（包括水和香烟）都不应该通过嘴唇。非穆斯林不受此限制，但仍应避免在公共场所饮食，因为这被认为是非常不礼貌的。企业界的工作时间也减少了。斋月的确切日期取决于当地的天文观测，并且因国家/地区而异。斋月以开斋节结束，开斋节可能持续数天，在大多数国家通常为三天。如果您计划在斋月期间前往也门，请考虑阅读斋月期间旅行。也门人、北非人和海湾阿拉伯人有着共同的文化；因此，阿拉伯世界所认为的礼貌也适用于也门。

ZM.etiquette: Zambians follow a strict patriarchal society – men are afforded more respect than women, and older men are respected more than younger men. However, you might find that a white person, of either gender and any age, is granted the most respect of all. A holdover from colonial times, this might make a traveller uncomfortable, but this is largely a Zambian's way of being courteous. Accept their hospitality. Zambians are a curious people. To a Western mindset, this might be interpreted as unnecessarily staring at you or talking about you in front of you. Be prepared to be greeted by kids yelling mzungu, mzungu! (literally, white man ) and answer lots of questions about yourself. Zambians love to shake hands, and you should oblige them. However, Zambians often like to hold hands for the duration of a conversation. This should not be interpreted as anything sexual; they are merely trying to "connect" with you. If you feel uncomfortable, simply pull your hand away.
ZM.title: Zambia

zh.etiquette: 赞比亚人遵循严格的父权社会——男性比女性受到更多尊重，年长男性比年轻男性更受到尊重。然而，您可能会发现白人，无论性别和年龄，都受到最尊重。这是殖民时代的遗留物，这可能会让旅行者感到不舒服，但这在很大程度上是赞比亚人的礼貌方式。接受他们的盛情款待。赞比亚人是一个充满好奇心的民族。对于西方人来说，这可能会被理解为不必要地盯着你或在你面前谈论你。准备好迎接孩子们大喊“mzungu，mzungu”！ （字面意思是白人）并回答很多关于你自己的问题。赞比亚人喜欢握手，你应该尊重他们。然而，赞比亚人经常喜欢在谈话过程中牵手。这不应被解释为任何与性有关的事情；他们只是想与你“联系”。如果您感到不舒服，只需将手移开即可。
